shared_elements: bearded male head with elaborate coiffure/headgear
low relief carving of figures on a flat panel
raised arm / hand holding or carrying an object
procession or figures facing one direction
justification: Both show bearded human figures rendered in shallow relief in strict profile, with carefully patterned hair/beard and an arm raised holding an object, and both include rosette motifs (a rosette on the object in A, rosette borders in B), which is a fairly specific shared convention. The main difference is subject: A is a single large winged supernatural figure filling the field, while B is a horizontal procession of small human attendants leading a two-humped camel between ornamental border bands.
